name: shield
description: Shield: a self-custodial commitment vault on Solana. Trade freely from a bankroll; refill it only by rules you set while calm.

scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:app && bun run typecheck:node
scripts.typecheck:node: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --types bun-types,node --lib es2022,dom client/shield-client.ts client/verdict.ts client/views.ts client/evm.ts client/solana-adapter.ts client/demo.ts client/recovery-cli.ts server/index.ts server/behaviour.ts server/policy.ts server/rpc-source.ts server/substreams-source.ts server/substreams-config.ts server/store.ts server/hyperliquid.ts server/evm-index.ts client/evm-demo.ts client/evm-state.ts scripts/anvil-demo.ts scripts/hyperevm-bootstrap.ts scripts/hyperevm-big-blocks.ts scripts/bootstrap-demo.ts scripts/print-verifier-seed.ts cre/shield-risk/evaluate.ts cre/shield-risk/evm-verdict.ts cre/shield-risk/dryrun.ts tests/harness.ts tests/shield-vault.test.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:program && bun run build:app
scripts.server:evm:anvil: SHIELD_PORT=8788 EVM_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545 EVM_CHAIN_ID=31337 EVM_START_BLOCK= SHIELD_VAULT_ADDRESS= USDC_ADDRESS= CORE_DEPOSIT_MOCK= SHIELD_EVM_VERIFIER_KEY= SHIELD_EVM_RELAYER_KEY= EVM_EXECUTION_KEY= EVM_DEMO_KEY= bun run server/evm-index.ts
scripts.dev:app:evm: cd app && VITE_SHIELD_CHAIN=evm VITE_SHIELD_API=http://localhost:8788 VITE_SHIELD_RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8545 VITE_EVM_CHAIN_ID=31337 VITE_SHIELD_VAULT_ADDRESS=0x9fE46736679d2D9a65F0992F2272dE9f3c7fa6e0 VITE_USDC_ADDRESS=0x5FbDB2315678afecb367f032d93F642f64180aa3 VITE_CORE_DEPOSIT_MOCK=0xe7f1725E7734CE288F8367e1Bb143E90bb3F0512 vite --port 5174
